overview_description.description: Taxfix Group is Europe’s leading financial platform for digital tax filing, with over 6 million submitted tax returns in Europe. Taxfix’s mission is to fix finances for all, ensuring everyone can navigate their finances with confidence. The platform with its brands Taxfix, Steuerbot and TaxScouts offers a broad range of innovative tax filing solutions tailored to diverse user needs and preferences: From the simple self-filing service app and browser solutions to the expert-service, a guided service where independent tax advisors handle the entire tax return process.

about_short_description.short_description: Taxfix Group is Europe’s leading financial platform for digital tax filing. Taxfix’s mission is to fix finances for all.

product.name: Taxfix Tax Platform
product.description: A web and mobile tax-filing platform that guides users through preparing and electronically submitting German income tax returns via the ELSTER interface.

product.name: Taxfix Basic
product.description: A self-service tax-filing product for preparing and submitting German income tax returns with guided questions, document extraction, refund estimates, and ELSTER transmission.

product.name: Taxfix Expert Service
product.description: A digital tax-preparation service in which independent tax advisers prepare a customer’s German tax return for review and approval through the Taxfix platform.

product.name: Taxfix+
product.description: A subscription that provides recurring access to Taxfix tax filing and year-round tools such as document storage, tax-related chat support, learning content, and additional filing benefits.

product.name: Taxfix for Self-Employed
product.description: A digital tax workflow for freelancers, sole proprietors, and small businesses covering supported income tax, bookkeeping, document management, and VAT filing tasks.

product.name: USt-Essentials
product.description: A software service for entrepreneurs that supports VAT advance returns, ongoing bookkeeping, receipt management, archiving, and technical transmission through ELSTER.
